newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS BROKERAGE MOST ACTIVE IN JUNE, H1 97.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS BROKERAGE MOST ACTIVE IN JUNE, H1 97.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that Vilniaus Bank was the country's most active brokerage house in June and in the first half of 1997.
The stock exchange said in a statement that Vilniaus Bank's brokerage house accounted for 27.76 percent of the market on turnover of 295.2 million litas during the first half of the year.

Its market share in T- bill trade stood at 42.84 percent on turnover of 165.72 million litas and it accounted for 19.14 percent of the bourse's equities trade on turnover of 129.5 million litas in the first half of 1997.
Vilniaus Bank's brokerage held over 29 percent of the total market in June on turnover of 29.8 million litas.
Vilniaus Bank was followed by Vilfima brokerage house with 15.95 percent of the market on turnover 189.6 million litas in the first half of the year.
Vilfima was the leader in trade on the securities market, accounting for almost 24 percent of it on turnover of 171.1 million litas in the first six month of 1997.
Vilfima's turnover in June was 14.98 million litas and its share of the market was 14.58 percent.
Suprema brokerage came third with 11.37 percent of the market with turnover of 120.96 million litas in the first half of 1997.
Its stake of the corporate securities trade amounted to 17.35 percent of the market on turnover of 117.56 million litas in the first half of the year.
